messages:
lee: dropping PR #4272  migration + SDK snippet refresh. aiming to merge in the 15:50 PT docs window. reviewers?
tara: I can do a docs/tone pass. quick reminder: swap 'organization' -> 'workspace' per glossary and avoid 'simple' in guidance.
mike: taking code. please use `Client.from_env()` in examples, no inline keys. also prefer generator streaming in snippets.
lee: updates pushed: switched examples to `Client.from_env()`, changed wording to 'workspace', trimmed long sentences. added a short before/after config table.
style-bot: style-check: passive voice found in migration step 3 -> consider active voice. also flag: term 'customers' used twice where 'developers' is clearer.
tara: tone pass: soften imperatives in the checklist ("Run this script" -> "You can run this script"). replace two instances of 'simple' with 'straightforward'. small punctuation nit in the bullet list.
mike: updated streaming snippet to generator form. changed:
```python
with client.stream_chat(prompt) as s:
    for c in s:
        print(c.text)
```
to:
```python
for c in client.stream_chat(prompt):
    print(c.text)
```
Added inline comment about backpressure.
lee: pushed anchor fix for migration.md (routing-fallbacks -> routing-fallbacks-overview).
ci-bot: Docs build failed: LinkCheckError in migration.md -> 'routing-fallbacks-overview' resolved to 404 in preview.
lee: oof, typo in header id. fixing now.
preview-bot: preview available: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4272 (interim) 
style-bot: small: prefer present-tense instructions in examples ("Use the SDK" -> "Use the SDK to"). non-blocking.
tara: one more suggestion: in the migration table, use monospace for flags and env var names. also add a one-line rollback command in runbook.
mike: added rollback cmd and clarified error handling in examples. left an optional suggestion to log chunk sizes in streaming example.
ci-bot: Docs build succeeded with 0 warnings.
preview-bot: final preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4272  all checks green.
tara: approving from docs POV. left the punctuation nit as a suggestion.
mike: approved.
lee: merging at 16:00 PT unless anyone objects.
lee: merged PR #4272   thanks team for the quick review and the tone fixes.
